site.title: Christopher Maldonado — Azure AI reference architectures
site.description: Reusable, deployable Azure AI reference architectures and demos by Christopher Maldonado: Foundry agents, AI gateways, RAG knowledge bases, document AI, voice AI, and Microsoft Fabric CI/CD.

profile.name: Christopher Maldonado
profile.headline: I build reusable Azure AI reference architectures you can actually deploy.
profile.bio: Each project here is a self-contained reference pattern: an architecture diagram, step-by-step docs, testing and troubleshooting guides, and — where it makes sense — an azd template so you can stand it up with a single command. The goal is to turn recurring Cloud & AI questions into working, inspectable starting points.
about: I'm a Solution Engineer at Microsoft focused on Cloud & AI, based in Texas. Most of my work sits where generative AI meets enterprise reality: identity, governance, cost control, observability, and getting from a demo to something a platform team can own.

The areas I spend the most time in are Azure AI Foundry and agents, AI gateways with Azure API Management, retrieval-augmented generation and document AI, real-time voice AI, and data platforms with Microsoft Fabric.
Everything listed here is a personal reference project published to GitHub. Fork it, adapt it, and open an issue if something is unclear.

projects.title: Secure Enterprise Agents Landing Zone
projects.useCase: Run enterprise AI agents securely: Foundry hosted agents behind an API Management AI gateway landing zone.
projects.description: An audit-first landing zone for Foundry hosted agents. Model and tool access is governed through an Azure API Management AI gateway, with agent identity, end-to-end trace correlation, and token metrics built in.
highlights: Foundry hosted agents fronted by an APIM AI gateway
Agent identity with Microsoft Entra Agent ID
Trace correlation and token metrics for audit
projects.thumbnailAlt: Architecture diagram: Foundry hosted agents behind an API Management AI gateway with identity, monitoring and network layers

projects.title: Governed MCP Tool Platform
projects.useCase: Enterprise governance for Model Context Protocol tools: one front door, identity propagation, and per-team quota and chargeback.
projects.description: Runs MCP servers at enterprise scale on Azure. API Management acts as the governance edge (onboarding, quota, token metering) while an MCP gateway runtime handles session-aware routing and dynamic server registration, with Entra identity propagated end to end.
highlights: API Management as the single AI and MCP front door
Identity propagation from caller to MCP server
projects.thumbnailAlt: Architecture diagram: API Management governance edge in front of an MCP gateway runtime on Kubernetes

projects.title: AI Cost Governance Gateway
projects.useCase: Real-time AI budget caps per team and agent, chargeback metrics, and governed MCP tools behind API Management.
projects.description: A management portal and governance API with Azure API Management as the AI and MCP gateway. Inference requests are admitted only when a conservative maximum charge fits the team's remaining budget, and token metrics are emitted by team, model, and caller for chargeback.
highlights: Budget is reserved before a model call is sent
Token metrics by team, model and caller for chargeback
Agents and service principals spend their team's budget

projects.title: Document Q&A Knowledge Agent
projects.useCase: A reusable RAG knowledge-base pattern: ask questions over your documents and get cited answers.
projects.description: A low-code-first, document-domain-agnostic RAG pattern. Documents are ingested with Microsoft Fabric and Document Intelligence into Azure AI Search, and the agent can be built two ways: Copilot Studio (default) or Foundry Agent Service.
highlights: Shared ingestion: Fabric, Document Intelligence, AI Search
Agent built in Copilot Studio or Foundry Agent Service
Grounded answers with citations; publish to Teams
projects.thumbnailAlt: Architecture diagram: Fabric and Document Intelligence ingestion into Azure AI Search, consumed by a Copilot Studio or Foundry agent

projects.title: Developer Docs Copilot Grounding
projects.useCase: Ground GitHub Copilot and VS Code agents in your technical documentation through an Azure AI Search knowledge base MCP endpoint.
projects.description: Turns a corpus of technical documents into an Azure AI Search knowledge base exposed over MCP, so GitHub Copilot and other MCP clients answer from your own docs instead of general knowledge.
projects.thumbnailAlt: Architecture diagram: technical documents indexed into an Azure AI Search knowledge base exposed to GitHub Copilot over MCP

projects.title: Invoice Extraction: Document Intelligence vs. Content Understanding
projects.useCase: Compare Azure Document Intelligence and Content Understanding side by side for invoices whose vendor layouts keep changing.
projects.description: A comparison harness that runs the same document through both services, normalizes the responses, and produces a side-by-side scorecard plus a tiered router. Runs fully offline in simulate mode when no Azure resources exist yet.
projects.thumbnailAlt: Architecture diagram: the same invoice routed through Document Intelligence and Content Understanding into a side-by-side scorecard

projects.title: Contact-Center Voice Agent Options
projects.useCase: Three ways to build a contact-center voice agent on Azure: Voice Live API, GPT Realtime API, and Foundry voice agents.
projects.description: Side-by-side, azd-deployable examples of the three main approaches to real-time voice agents on Azure, on a shared platform, with guidance on when to choose each and how to connect telephony.
projects.thumbnailAlt: Architecture diagram: shared platform hosting Voice Live API, GPT Realtime API and Foundry voice agent options

projects.title: Voice Avatar Customer Assistant
projects.useCase: A real-time voice customer assistant with a lifelike avatar, built on the Azure AI Voice Live API.
projects.description: Combines the Voice Live API with a real-time text-to-speech avatar for a natural, face-to-face customer assistant experience. Deploys with azd up, with an optional local fallback pipeline.
projects.thumbnailAlt: Architecture diagram: browser client streaming audio to the Voice Live API with a real-time avatar

projects.title: Fabric Dev-to-Prod CI/CD
projects.useCase: Promote Microsoft Fabric items from Dev to Prod with Azure DevOps, Git integration, and per-environment Direct Lake values.
projects.description: A workshop-style pattern comparing three CI/CD paths for Microsoft Fabric with Azure DevOps: Fabric Git integration, parameterized Direct Lake connections per environment, and a decision guide for choosing the right path.
projects.thumbnailAlt: Architecture diagram: Azure DevOps pipelines promoting Fabric items from a Dev workspace to a Prod workspace
